lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance quasi-circular nodes arranged in a predictable 2D grid. Columns are oriented vertically following the animal's curvature, with node size and spacing increasing in the posterior direction relative to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a coordinate-like matrix where blobs function as primary anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from light (superior) to shadow (inferior) across the ridge apex.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs concentrated in the basal and mid-posterior regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several elongated dark silhouettes (commensal fish) positioned ventrally and posterior to the left pectoral fin.
